_comment: Synthetic split manifest frozen before training (see references/ml-analysis.md, 'Training on data and blinding'): simulated events (sim-NN) and sideband data events (sb-NN) grouped by run, timestamps in hours since the start of the period. No group crosses splits and the splits are in time order, so check_split_integrity.py passes. Its file SHA-256 is named in pretraining-decision.example.json. Illustrative only, not from any experiment.
